title: Exact center symmetry and first-order phase transition in QCD with three degenerate dynamical quarks
summary: We study QCD with three degenerate flavors of dynamical quarks using first-principles lattice simulations. For a specific choice of imaginary isospin chemical potential, this theory possesses an exact center symmetry, just like pure gauge theory. This exact symmetry is expected to be intact at low temperatures and spontaneously broken in the high-temperature regime. By analyzing the finite-size scaling of the Polyakov loop distribution, obtained with a dedicated multi-histogram approach, we demonstrate that there is a first-order deconfinement phase transition in between.
